hook_text: From Cape Town to Johannesburg, the view changes, and so do the jobs. Why?
clip_script: A long-distance train leaves Cape Town. The harbour: ships and fishing. The Hex River Valley: rich soil, water and vineyards of table grapes. Up through tunnels onto the plateau: the dry Karoo, with sheep, windmills and tiny towns far apart. Then the flat Highveld: maize fields, mines and the city of gold. Physical features decide where people live and what they do. And where nature is in the way, people build tunnels and dams.
visual_style: Whiteboard train window with the landscape scrolling by: harbour, vineyards, tunnel, dry Karoo, maize fields, city skyline.
mood: Rolling and curious, like a long journey watching the world go by.
pacing: Steady train rhythm, one landscape per beat, ending at the city.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and explain why your own town grew where it did.
